tranche1Split.policy: DEV briefs may be used to develop and debug the TOOL SURFACE. HELDOUT briefs are never inspected while iterating; they are authored once through the frozen, unmodified surface. The reported number is the generalization gap in admission rate.

tranche2Split.policy: Tranche 2 extends the corpus toward requirement A (~100 admitted archetypes). Same discipline: DEV may be used to improve the ALGORITHM; HELDOUT is authored once through a hash-frozen surface. Tranche 1 (92 briefs, split dd4f360c) is UNCHANGED and remains the head-to-head lane comparison set.
tranche2Split.weightedToward: categories with 0-1 admitted archetypes after round 4: C13, C3, C4, C6, C12, C14, C9
